requirement_to_green: per-customer time-of-day habits (true local timestamps; card, app and branch events for the same customer)
customer activity with a real daily rhythm (true local timestamps, declared clock); a profile only predicts when customers have habits
an intraday arrival profile (real timestamps in local time); at least 26 weeks of hourly history per series
ATM-level cash events (terminal id, dispense, replenishment) with an intraday withdrawal profile
teller sessions tied to the branch schedule (opening days and hours per branch, holiday closures) and a teller or terminal identifier per transaction
workforce data: rostered shifts per agent and day, login/logout and state logs (available, on break, in call), so occupancy and adherence can be measured
an intraday contact profile (real timestamps); queue and abandonment events from the telephony system
an SLA flag consistent with the measured clock (deadline per case type and country, business-hours calendar), and the case's linked contact (origin_interaction_id)
case work queues and assignment rules, agent capacity per hour, and the regulatory deadline per case type and country

requirement_to_green: opens with a real delay distribution (tracked opens for every channel, device and local time of the open) and randomised send times to learn the effect of the hour
